args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson 2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the first fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`
- `CHANGELOG.md`: added entry under Unreleased

## Testing

CI passed on branch `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` (run `ci-0001`).

2. **Created a branch**: `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` from `main`.

3. **Made the fix**:

The PR is open and awaiting review from alex. I did not merge it, since merging into `main` requires code-owner approval per policy.
